title: Home coordinates out of git, layered workout detection, and removal of the test hook
objective: Give the geofence its anchor without recording where the user lives in the repository, and replace the root-only workout detector with sources an unrooted app can actually read. Success is coordinates living only in app-private storage, a workout signal that fails closed on every path, and the temporary test receiver gone before it can reach a provisioned build.
acceptance_criteria: Home coordinates are pushed from the untracked config_secrets.sh to app-private storage; nothing coordinate-shaped enters git
The shipped REDACTED_* placeholder is rejected with a message naming the file to fill in, not written as a nonsense coordinate
The provisioned file is mode 600 and unreadable by the shell user
The staging copy under /data/local/tmp is removed after the transfer
A missing, malformed, or out-of-range coordinate file reads as null rather than throwing, so the enforcement layer treats it as location-unknown and fails closed
Every workout source fails closed: a throwing or hanging probe reports no workout
The manual signal is time-boxed rather than a plain toggle
The combined signal can name which source opened the exception
HideTestReceiver is absent from the source, the manifest, and the installed APK
out_of_scope: Device Owner provisioning and the factory reset
The Health Connect query implementation - the guarded wrapper exists, the platform call does not yet
The foreground service, BOOT_COMPLETED receiver and alarm scheduling
com.kuhy.workout_app and org.runnerup as sources: verified unusable and absent respectively
verifier: focus_owner/scripts/push_home_location.sh (both the placeholder-rejection and success paths) then --check; adb run-as ls -la to confirm mode 600; adb shell cat to confirm the shell cannot read it; cd focus_owner && flutter analyze && flutter test; rebuild, reinstall, and dumpsys package | grep -c HideTest
